name: Fiery Siege

automation.text: You touch a siege weapon, imbuing it with pyroclastic power. For the duration, the siege weapon deals an extra 1d10 Fire damage when it hits. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a different siege engine, transferring the effect to it.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
description:
You touch a siege weapon, imbuing it with pyroclastic power. For the duration, the siege weapon deals an extra 1d10 Fire damage when it hits. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a different siege engine, transferring the effect to it.

Use `-d 1d10[fire]` to add extra damage to an attack.
